exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.
availability.purchase: Installing one is a single deterministic purchase costing exactly two units of its assigned specialized material.

effects.microMissileTargeting: They select distinct nearby targets before assigning extras, so all three may hit one durable target only when no alternatives are available.

rules.text: Each missile splits once into three micro-missiles at half of its remaining travel distance or 1.0 s before predicted impact, whichever comes first.

Each micro-missile deals 45% current Damage and has 50% current blast radius. They select distinct nearby targets before assigning extras, so all three may hit one durable target only when no alternatives are available.
Micro-missiles inherit current speed and turn rate and cannot split again.
Total direct payload per original missile is 135% current Damage, with more target distribution and less area per impact.
